addons.name: Earth Bus Routes
addons.author: Robitnik
addons.summary: Drive real bus lines anywhere on Earth: stops and routes from OpenStreetMap, real timetables in Czechia, passengers, a HUD, stop markers, shifts with a dispatcher, a career, your own routes. Needs its data service.

addons.name: Earth Bus Routes data service
addons.author: Robitnik
addons.summary: Fetches bus stops, routes and roads from OpenStreetMap for Earth Bus Routes (runs beside the game, listens on 127.0.0.1 only).
